preconditions.description: The number of nodes (n) and queries (m) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each initial node value a_i is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n for v_i, u_i in edges)
preconditions.description: The tree has exactly n-1 edges, and each edge connects two valid nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(query[0] == 1 or query[0] == 2 for query in queries) and all(1 <= x <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 1 or query[0] == 2) and all(1 <= val <= 1000 for query in queries if query[0] == 1)
preconditions.description: Each query is either type 1 (add val to node x) or type 2 (print value of node x), with valid node and value constraints.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line == str(current_values[x - 1]) for i, (query_type, x, val) in enumerate(queries) if query_type == 2 for stdout_line in output_lines[i])
postconditions.description: For each type-2 query, the output line is the current value of node x after all preceding operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= current_values[i] <= 1000000 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: After all operations, each node's value is within a reasonable range (no negative or excessively large values due to propagation).

invariants.expression: all(1 <= child <= n for parent in range(n) for child in children[parent])
invariants.description: The tree structure is maintained such that each node's children are valid nodes.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= parent <= n for child in range(n) for parent in parents[child])
invariants.description: The parent-child relationship is bidirectional and valid.
